Go inside @gracieabrams’ world ❤️🎶

The singer-songwriter shares the creative process behind her new album “Daughter from Hell” –  nature, dancing and the quiet in between. 

“Sometimes it can be surprising how strange and out-of-body the songwriting process can be – that an idea can come fully formed just like that, and five seconds prior it didn’t exist,” says Gracie. “Self-doubt is a theme in lots of my songs, but I’m learning to trust myself more and more as I grow up.” 💫
